description: This file defines a React functional component called IngestionPage, which provides a user interface for data ingestion via file upload or fetching from an external API. It manages state for API URL, result data, and loading state, and interacts with external services ingestFromAPI and ingestFromFile.

methods.name: onFile
methods.description: Handles file upload events to ingest data from a user-selected file by calling ingestFromFile and updating the component state.

methods.name: onAPI
methods.description: Handles API fetch events to ingest data from the specified API URL by calling ingestFromAPI and updating the component state.
